description: Figure 16b illustrates the relationship between confidence and accuracy for the MMLU dataset across different iterations. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and also has a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.10. There are three lines displayed: a green dashed line representing “Final Accuracy,” a magenta dashed line representing “Δ Accuracy,” and a blue solid line representing “Initial Accuracy.” The “Initial Accuracy” line begins at approximately 0.28 at an initial confidence of 0.00 and ends at approximately 0.30 at a confidence of 1.00, showing a generally steady trend. The “Final Accuracy” line starts at approximately 0.62 at an initial confidence of 0.00 and ends at approximately 0.64 at a confidence of 1.00, also showing a generally steady trend. The “Δ Accuracy” line begins at approximately 0.34 at an initial confidence of 0.00, declines to approximately 0.24 at a confidence of 0.30, then rises to approximately 0.34 at a confidence of 1.00, exhibiting a decline followed by an increase.
